detail:
Decisions: Chose to delete the tools: allowlist from both plugin agent definitions rather than substitute the correct mcp__* prefixed names — the MCP server prefix is install-mode dependent (mcp__plugin_twining_twining__* for a plugin install vs mcp__twining__* for a standalone .mcp.json entry), so any hardcoded prefix breaks one install mode; omitting tools: inherits everything and is prefix-agnostic; Chose to rewrite the auto-invocable twining-decide skill around twining_record instead of merely annotating twining_decide as full-surface-only — every numbered step of that skill (decide, override/reconsider, the REQUIRED link_commit, promote) used a full-surface-only tool, so the core decision-recording workflow failed end-to-end on every default install; twining_record is default-surface and routes to the same decision store, and its commit_hash/supersedes/depends_on fields cover link_commit and supersession; Chose a doc-level full_surface caveat for the coordination skills (coordinate, dispatch, handoff, review, map, orient, export) rather than promoting those tools to the default surface — promoting them is a product decision about whether the coordination surface is in scope for v2, which is the owner's call, not a review fix; Chose a static registration-introspection test (recording stub server with null engines) over spawning the server and listing tools over JSON-RPC — registration only touches server.registerTool and never dereferences engines, so the stub enumerates the real default and full surfaces with no process or fixture cost; Bumped the plugin minor to 1.23.0 rather than patch — spawned agents that previously launched with zero twining tools now inherit them, which is a behavior change for plugin consumers, not a content-only refresh
Findings: warning: A verification subagent modified test/eval/scorers/argument-quality.ts and quality-criteria.ts in the working tree during the review despite instructions not to mutate the repo, then reverted them. A full-suite run taken during that window was measuring a tree that included unattributed agent edits — re-ran clean afterward (109 files, 1452 passed, 2 skipped). Treat read-only review agents as capable of writes unless sandboxed.; The eval scorers argument-quality.ts:53 and quality-criteria.ts:114 check call.arguments['alternatives_considered'], but no such parameter exists anywhere in src/ — the real twining_decide/twining_record parameter is 'alternatives'. Correct real transcripts therefore fail these MUST checks. Independently verified by grep; fix NOT applied (left for the eval-harness pass).; twining_post rejects summaries over 200 chars while twining_record truncates them — the inconsistency bit this session twice on the mid-session finding path, which is exactly the path that should have the least friction.; The new test/plugin-tool-references.test.ts caught 8 additional drifted files beyond the 2 agent definitions: 7 skills plus the export command teach full-surface-only tools as if always available.; need: Product decision required on whether the coordination surface (register/agents/discover/delegate, plus deprecated handoff/acknowledge) is in scope — it is default-off, partly deprecated, and still taught by plugin skills, so the marketed surface and the reachable surface are disjoint.
summary: Fixed the confirmed field bug: plugin agents/skills referenced tool names no install registers; added CI guard test
